messages.text:
At 12–20¢ most home units run roughly $20–45 a month in power. The B.4 itself isn't buyable right now — the drop slipped to mid-October with no day set.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30 Hammer BC04 NerdOctaxe

For a first miner, the closest thing to what you were looking at is the Harlo B30: $899, ~30 TH/s, about 400W — roughly $46 a month at 16¢. Quiet, ~50 dB, plug-and-play. Ships Nov 30, 2026.

If you'd rather start small today, the Hammer BC04 is $239, 6 TH/s, in stock. Which way are you leaning?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-4 numbers for where you live.
